# ATTRIBUTION for the FLT slice

Rows copied verbatim from the upstream `ATTRIBUTION.md` of anthropics/fermats-last-theorem (commit aa2d8b34692b16c70f699536de0d8e75b9a3e9ef) for the files in this slice. Upstream published its Lean sources without comments, so attribution headers did not survive in place; these rows restore the per-file notices for third-party material (the Imperial College London FLT project and Mathlib, both Apache-2.0). Files not listed carry no identified third-party material beyond the upstream repository itself (Copyright 2026 Anthropic, PBC, Apache-2.0; see `NOTICE`).
